findings.claim: Arm 於 2026 年 3 月起商業模式由純 IP 授權擴展到自家設計的矽產品（Arm AGI CPU），預計 2026 年底前量產。
findings.excerpt: As of March 2026, we also expanded our offerings to include Arm-designed silicon products with the introduction of the Arm AGI CPU, with production expected by the end of calendar year 2026.

findings.claim: Arm 自有晶片與授權客戶（AWS、Google、Microsoft、NVIDIA 等）存在通路衝突疑慮；Meta 為首發客戶。
findings.source: eWeek: Arm Enters the AI Chip Market With New AGI Processor
findings.excerpt: Meta Platforms is Arm’s first official customer for the AGI CPU, with early customers including OpenAI, Cloudflare, SAP, SK Telecom, and Cerebras.
